capabilities: quiz question lines in the current note via a command
reveal answers rendered with Obsidian's Markdown renderer
choose Correct or Wrong and append ✅/❌ marks to source question lines
filter quizzes to wrong or unmarked questions and clear existing marks
run folder-wide quizzes, save dated score reports, and store marker presets (Pro)
extras: Freemium: current-note quizzes, filters, score, and source marks are free; folder quizzes, dated score reports, and marker presets require Pro. After updates it opens a What's new tab promoting other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat (can be disabled). README states physical phones, tablets, themes, and screen readers were not tested; remote images in answers can trigger network requests.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to quiz yourself on question-and-answer lines in a note and record the results back into the note text.

relations.evidence: The mark format matches Simple Note Quiz 1.1.1.

requires.name: GitHub Sponsors sponsorship of theluckystrike ($5/month or $15 once)

summary: Quiz plugin that turns question lines in the current note into a reveal-answer review with Correct/Wrong scoring and optional emoji marks written back to the source.
